name: agy-delegate
tagline_zh: 把编码任务丢给 Antigravity 后台跑，你只审 diff 再合并。像雇了个隐形程序员，活干完你说了算。
tagline_en: Hand coding tasks to Antigravity in the background, review the diff, and merge. It's like a silent coder—you keep.
desc_en: Delegate a coding task to the Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Antigravity or agy - phrasings like "have Antigravity do X", "delegate this to agy", "run it through agy", or "use Antigravity to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through
why_zh: 同类工具只负责生成代码，它却把审查和合并留给你，既提速又不失控。
why_en: Unlike tools that just generate code, it keeps you in the loop with diff review and merge—speed without losing control.
